record.title: Evaluate stock rollback and release or hold the RF comparison
record.intent: Resolve the first physical transition before relying on stock as an experimental arm.
requirements: Independently assess exact one-reboot delivery, new boot and stock mappings,17/17 witness, normal UI, logical preservation, fresh capture and thermal/deadline readiness. Success must not be inferred solely from connectivity.

On success supply evidence to the original execution decision for the already proposed stock-derived-stock comparison, with finalstock explicit. On failure leave the original gate open and record the exact failure; no automatic native reinstatement or repeated reboot is admitted.
Commit and push the conclusion before the next arm transition; preserve original protocol and specimen evidence and do not convert a completed preparation or rollback task into a positive RF result.
acceptance: A supported go or hold disposition reconciles the stock baseline with the original RF gate.
